GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2022-05-05T06:14:56Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Clickhouse use multiple columns in group by clause
Description: 
Hi All, I am using the below query to generate materialized view for clickhouse but i want the result to be seperate by both the names ( name_top_apps, name_remote_top_emdpoints) can anyone help on this one

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW IF NOT EXISTS analytics.uflow_topapps_bytes_flowdir_or_013_mv
  ENGINE = SummingMergeTree
  PARTITION BY toYYYYMMDD ( Timestamp )
  ORDER BY (Timestamp)
  POPULATE
  AS SELECT
  toString(AppId) as name_top_apps,
  IPv6NumToString(DstIP) as name_remote_top_emdpoints,
  sum(FlowStatsBytesFwd) as upload_bytes,
  sum(FlowStatsBytesRev) as download_bytes, 
  sum(FlowStatsBytesFwd + FlowStatsBytesRev) as cumulative_bytes,
  sum(FlowStatsPktsFwd) as upload_flows,
  sum(FlowStatsPktsFwd) as download_flows,
  sum(FlowStatsPktsFwd + FlowStatsPktsRev) as cumulative_flows,
  toInt64((sum(FlowStatsBytesFwd)* 8)/least(sum(Duration),60)) as upload_rate,
  toInt64((sum(FlowStatsBytesRev)* 8)/least(sum(Duration),60)) as download_rate,
  toInt64(((sum(FlowStatsBytesRev) + sum(FlowStatsBytesFwd)) * 8)/least(sum(Duration),60)) as cumulative_rate,
  toStartOfInterval(`Timestamp`, INTERVAL 300 second) AS Timestamp,
  CpeCNID as  CpeCNID
  from analytics.sampled_uflow where AccessDenied = 0 and ( FlowDir == 2 or FlowDir == 0 or FlowDir == 3 )
  Group by ( CpeCNID, name_top_apps, name_remote_top_emdpoints, Timestamp)
